note: pillars-v4 with a shares-outstanding fallback for the float pillar (owner decision 2026-11-22): where no usable float is visible (no record, a null or zero figure, or a stale one) but a usable shares-outstanding figure is, and it is below the float maximum, the pillar PASSes with reason below_max_via_outstanding. The public float can never exceed the shares outstanding, so an outstanding figure under 20M proves the float is under 20M; an outstanding figure at or above the maximum proves nothing and the pillar stays UNKNOWN. A null or zero is never a pass. On 2026-11-20 FMP had 1,026 of 3,409 float rows null (no_row), which kept otherwise qualifying symbols off the Ross Panel for good. All other rules are unchanged. pillars-v1 to v4 remain frozen historical policies.
